name: GhostToolbar
description: Themed wrapper around headless GhostToolbar. Same behavioral props; flex row/column layout from default CSS. Hand-written until GHO-13 generates manifests.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Toolbar layout forwarded to the unstyled GhostToolbar.

props.name: loop
props.description: Roving wrap behavior forwarded to the unstyled GhostToolbar.

props.name: dir
props.description: Text direction for horizontal arrows, forwarded to the unstyled GhostToolbar.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name forwarded to the unstyled GhostToolbar.

props.name: as
props.description: Root element forwarded to the unstyled GhostToolbar.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Toolbar items forwarded to the unstyled GhostToolbar.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Root toolbar element inside the themed scope.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The toolbar element inside the display:contents themed scope.

keyboard.ArrowLeft: Previous enabled item when orientation is horizontal.
keyboard.ArrowRight: Next enabled item when orientation is horizontal.
keyboard.ArrowUp: Previous enabled item when orientation is vertical.
keyboard.ArrowDown: Next enabled item when orientation is vertical.
